test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 79

questions.question: Chandana starts from Point T and drives west for 55 km. She takes a left turn, drives for 20 km and then takes a right turn, drives for 20 km, and stops at Point O. Raveena starts to drive from Point M, which is 40 km to the north of Point O. She drives 75 km towards the east, then takes a right turn and drives for 10 km, and stops at Point Y. What is the shortest distance between Point Y and Point T? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)(6, 11, 19)(7, 12, 21)
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?21, 25, 33, 45, 61, ?
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then the resultant of which of the following would be 200?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (50 B 4 C 10 A 2 D 5) है।

questions.question: This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)     217     916     406     448     463     (Right)(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.) What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1 – P, A, R and K are seated, and all of them are facing south.In row 2 – T, U, V and W are seated, and all of them are facing north.Thus, each person faces another person from the other row. W faces the one sitting to the immediate right of K. Only one person sits between W and T. Only two people sit between U and T. T faces the one sitting second to the left of A. R sits at some place to the right of P. Which of the following represents both people sitting at extreme ends of the rows?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (T and R) है।

questions.question: P, Q, R, S, T and U live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. T lives on an even-numbered floor but not on floor number 4. S does not live on the lowermost floor. Q lives immediately below P. There are exactly two floors between R and S. U lives immediately above T. Who lives on the topmost floor?
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 10 D 2 B 40 C 49 A 7 = ?

‘A ¥ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,‘A x B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’, ‘A % B’ means ‘A is the son of B’ and‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.Which of the following means that O is the brother's wife's brother of S?
options: O ¥ M x I % T + S
O + M x I ¥ T % S
O x M + I % T ¥ S
O x M + I ¥ T % S
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (O x M + I % T ¥ S) है।

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. V has an exam on Tuesday. Exactly 3 people have exams between V and T. S has an exam immediately before R, and Q has an exam immediately after R. Only 1 person has an exam between S and P. Who has an exam on Monday?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:No tiger is a ball.No ball is a peacock.No ball is an hen.Conclusions:(I): No tiger is a peacock.(II): Some hens are peacocks.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows) है।

questions.question: This question is based on the following words.(Left)   VAN   MUD   EAR   DON  (Right)How many letters are there between the second letter of the first word from the right and the second letter of the first word from the left as per the English alphabetical order?

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement:Despite being a major agricultural hub, District A faces food security issues and relies heavily on food imports.Reasons:I. District A experiences challenges such as erratic weather patterns and water scarcity that affect agricultural productivity.II. District A lacks the necessary transportation infrastructure to import food efficiently.
options: Only I is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only I is a possible reason.) है।
